description: This file defines the ApiError class representing a standard error response payload for REST APIs in the KYC service platform. It includes fields for timestamp, status code, error message, detailed message, request path, and additional details.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: A Java class representing standardized error information for REST API responses, including timestamp, status, error message, request path, and additional details.

methods.name: ApiError
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing all fields of ApiError.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the error.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the error.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the error.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the request path associated with the error.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns additional details related to the error.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets additional details related to the error.
